R1096.note: Moves label/refreshSeconds into HTML-encoded data attributes, decoded at runtime via getAttribute/parseInt; title encoding and number type both preserved per contract.

R1097.note: Move-captures the unique_ptr into the lambda so the Session outlives the enqueue; idiomatic C++, matches the contract's ownership option.

R1098.note: archive/tar eliminates the shell entirely (correct shape), but the write-up openly admits ctx is no longer used for cancellation, contradicting the stated contract to keep the request context for cancellation.

R1099.note: Image.TryIdentifyFormat is not a real ImageSharp API - confirmed by compiling against SixLabors.ImageSharp 3.1.5 and 4.1.1, both fail with CS0117 (real API is Image.DetectFormat/Image.Identify); code will not compile.

R1100.note: Missing @Html.Raw around JsonSerializer.Serialize means Razor's implicit HtmlEncoder still runs on the JSON output (verified: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode turns "Sales Dashboard" into "Sales Dashboard"), which <script> blocks never HTML-decode, so the widget breaks with a JS syntax error for every label, benign or malicious - not disclosed in the write-up, which claims the output is valid JavaScript.

R1101.note: toRealPath() + startsWith() containment check correctly rejects traversal; explanation over-attributes the bug to symlinks rather than the missing containment check, but the fix itself is sound and matches the contract.

R1102.note: StackExchange.Redis IDatabase.HashSet with HashEntry args is the correct parameterized replacement for hand-built RESP inline commands, but it changes SessionNoteWriter's constructor from Socket to IDatabase, a breaking change for existing callers; disclosed in the explanation.

R1103.note: Content-sniffing allowlist, random filename, O_EXCL, size limits - correct shape; the response-body change (returns generated filename as JSON) is disclosed and necessary since the original filename is discarded.

R1104.note: Switches ECB to CBC with a random IV prepended to ciphertext, a standard and disclosed format change with no other consumer in scope.

R1105.note: Tika content-sniffing (confirmed real API by compiling tika-core 2.9.1), allowlist, UUID filenames, non-webroot storage, CREATE_NEW - all verified to compile/run correctly; type/location changes are exactly the intended fix and are disclosed.

R1106.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist is the correct approach and preserves the wire format, but the pattern (OrderEvent + java.lang/java.util only) is a guess at OrderEvent's actual field types (not shown in the case); write-up discloses this as something to verify/adjust, so a real domain object with other field types (e.g. BigDecimal, dates) could be rejected.

R1107.note: Adds secure:true (the reported finding) plus sameSite:lax, consistent with the SSO redirect flow described in the code; no legitimate use affected.

R1108.note: SecureRandom + Base64 URL-safe encoding is a valid cookie value and preserves the read/compare flow using the same variable.

R1109.note: Logs details server-side via slog and returns a generic 500 message; success path and status code unchanged.

R1110.note: Pins jwt.verify to algorithms:['RS256'], the standard fix for RS/HS algorithm confusion; matches the code's documented RS256-only usage.

R1111.note: Regex-reject approach correctly blocks CR and interior LF, but anchors with $ instead of \Z, so Python's re allows one trailing bare \n before end-of-string to pass validation (confirmed behavior of Python's re module); narrow and not clearly exploitable given the literal '>' that follows in the built command, but an undisclosed residual quirk in the validation.

R1112.note: Standard null-check on weak_ptr::lock() result; scoped shared_ptr does not extend lifetime beyond the call, matching the contract.

R1113.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist pattern correctly covers RestoredSession's actual fields (two Strings, fully within java.base), and the existing catch block already converts filter rejections to IllegalArgumentException per contract.
